{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Expense Churn", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of R&D expenses over the past 5 years, scaled by average total assets over the same period.", "rationale": "High R&D expense churn may indicate firms struggling to find profitable projects, leading to lower future returns. Firms with more stable R&D expenses may be better at allocating resources.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Trade Credit Ratio", "construction": "Compute the ratio of accounts payable to cost of goods sold, averaged over the past 3 years.", "rationale": "Firms with high trade credit ratios may be taking advantage of supplier financing, indicating strong bargaining power and potential for higher returns. This ratio can signal a firm's ability to manage working capital.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Volatility", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of year-over-year changes in the number of employees over the past 10 years, scaled by average total employees over the same period.", "rationale": "High employee growth volatility may signal poor management of human capital, leading to lower future returns. Firms with more stable employee growth may be better at managing their workforce.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability Exposure", "construction": "Estimate the ratio of environmental lawsuit settlements to total assets, averaged over the past 5 years.", "rationale": "Firms with high environmental liability exposure may face significant future costs, leading to lower returns. This measure can signal a firm's potential environmental risks.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Fund Asset Allocation", "construction": "Compute the ratio of pension fund assets allocated to equity investments, averaged over the past 3 years.", "rationale": "Firms with pension funds allocated more heavily to equity investments may be taking on excessive risk, leading to lower future returns. This ratio can signal a firm's overall risk tolerance.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration Index", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl index of customer sales concentrations, using data from the past 5 years.", "rationale": "Firms with high customer concentration may be vulnerable to losses if major customers withdraw their business, leading to lower future returns. This index can signal a firm's customer diversification.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Executive Stock Option Burn Rate", "construction": "Compute the ratio of executive stock option exercises to total shares outstanding, averaged over the past 3 years.", "rationale": "Firms with high executive stock option burn rates may be incentivizing managers to prioritize short-term gains over long-term value creation, leading to lower future returns. This ratio can signal a firm's executive compensation structure.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Labor Union Coverage Ratio", "construction": "Estimate the ratio of unionized employees to total employees, using data from the past 5 years.", "rationale": "Firms with high labor union coverage may face higher labor costs and reduced flexibility, leading to lower future returns. This ratio can signal a firm's labor relations and potential labor cost risks.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Foreign Tax Haven Exposure", "construction": "Compute the ratio of foreign earnings to total earnings, averaged over the past 3 years, and weight by a tax haven indicator variable.", "rationale": "Firms with high foreign tax haven exposure may be engaging in aggressive tax avoidance, potentially leading to future tax liabilities and lower returns. This measure can signal a firm's tax risk and potential for future tax liabilities.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Corporate Governance Entrenchment Index", "construction": "Calculate an index of corporate governance provisions, including staggered boards, poison pills, and golden parachutes, using data from the past 5 years.", "rationale": "Firms with high corporate governance entrenchment may be insulating managers from shareholder pressure, leading to lower future returns. This index can signal a firm's level of managerial entrenchment and potential for agency problems.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
